title: Harvested Pear Carrot and Cabbage Set
description: Original editable harvested-food kit containing a shouldered pear with a thin stem, one complete tapered carrot with three folded leaves, and a rounded cabbage with three thick overlapping outer leaves. Each food uses a distinct continuous volume and named closed components, rather than recoloured sphere variants. Muted whole-food colours, no labels or external textures. Three foods count as one set ID. Static display placement only; no food preparation, growth, deformation or physical simulation.
